# Charles Brennan

> Charles Brennan is an operational and technology advisor and Senior Analyst at Nucleus Research,
> based in Miami, Florida. He specializes in enterprise software evaluation, supply chain and
> manufacturing systems, technology market intelligence, and ROI analysis.

## Who he is

Charles Brennan began his career in warehouse operations at TLF Apparel in April 2021, starting as a
warehouse associate picking and packing orders, and moved into a Supply Chain Business Analyst role.
He joined Nucleus Research in July 2022 as an analyst and grew into a senior analyst and research and
advisory leadership role. That sequence matters: he evaluates enterprise technology as someone who has
run the operations the software is sold to improve.

## What he specializes in

- Enterprise software evaluation and vendor selection
- Supply chain planning (SCP), WMS, TMS, OMS, and control towers
- Manufacturing execution (MES), quality management (QMS), and PLM
- Source-to-pay and procurement, AR management, IIoT data platforms
- ROI analysis, business cases, and value realization
- Technology market and competitive intelligence
- AI in enterprise and supply chain operations

## Research

164 published research reports on the Nucleus Research website and the Bloomberg Terminal,
covering Supply Chain Management (106), Enterprise Applications (57), Analytics (1).
Report types include Value Matrix vendor evaluations, ROI case studies, and market research notes.
